siren_signal — DRIVE decide op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.siren_signal(duration: 'float', fs: 'float', *, f_high: 'float' = 960.0, f_low: 'float' = 770.0, period: 'float' = 1.3, source_start=(-60.0, 10.0), source_velocity=(15.0, 0.0), mics=((0.0, 0.0),), c: 'float' = 343.0, spreading: 'bool' = True, mic_velocity=(0.0, 0.0), mic_track=None) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivedecide; drivedecide.siren_signal(duration: 'float', fs: 'float', *, f_high: 'float' = 960.0, f_low: 'float' = 770.0, period: 'float' = 1.3, source_start=(-60.0, 10.0), source_velocity=(15.0, 0.0), mics=((0.0, 0.0),), c: 'float' = 343.0, spreading: 'bool' = True, mic_velocity=(0.0, 0.0), mic_track=None) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("siren_signal"))

Usage

Synthesizes the sound of a moving ambulance siren (alternating two tones) as heard by a stationary microphone.

Source p(τ) = source_start + source_velocity·τ (2D, uniform straight-line motion); the emitted sound is sin φ(τ), where φ is a continuous phase that alternates a high tone f_high and a low tone f_low for period/2 each. The sound microphone m hears at time t is sin φ(τ) at the emission time τ satisfying

c (t − τ) = |p(τ) − m| ⇔ (c² − |u|²) s² + 2 (q·u) s − |q|² = 0, s = t − τ ≥ 0, q = p(t) − m

(amplitude r_ref / r with spreading, r_ref = the initial distance). The Doppler formula is not used (only the geometry of arrival times), so this is an independent path for the gate of doppler_track.

mic_velocity = constant velocity of the microphone (or the ego vehicle carrying it) (relative to air = ground; no wind). The microphone moves as m(t) = m₀ + u_L t. The equation above keeps the same form with q = p(t) − m(t) (c(t − τ) = |p(τ) − m(t)|, p(τ) = p(t) − u s). Only the microphone position at reception time enters the quadratic (the source moves uniformly), so the microphone may move along any path:

giving mic_track = (position (k, n, 2), velocity (k, n, 2)) per sample uses it instead of mics / mic_velocity (a microphone on an ego vehicle that decelerates and pulls to the left; the velocity is used only for the closed form of dτ/dt).

Return value: t (n,), signals (number of mics, n), tau (same), f_emit (same, emitted frequency), v_radial (same, the rate of change of distance in the approaching direction −d|p(τ) − m(t)|/dt "converted to the source's line-of-sight speed" c(1 − 1/D), D = dτ/dt. If the microphone is stationary, same as −ṙ at emission time), range_rate (same, time derivative of the geometric distance |p(τ) − m(t)| at reception; negative = approaching), f_true (same, = f_emit · dτ/dt. Closed form dτ/dt = (c + r̂·u_L)/(c + r̂·u_S), r̂ = the unit vector (p(τ) − m(t))/r).
